title: Samurai Troopers Memorials, Volume 2
originalTitle: サムライトルーパー・メモリアルズ下巻
summary: Covers episodes 20-39 with a poster, film digest, armor and Kaos-family explanations, setting materials, character profiles, early planning documents, and staff interviews. It fares better than the first volume thanks to stronger illustrations and more substantial armor lore, including notes on the pre-title project 'Chogokenshi Aram Shaddar'.
